scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome to the
Kafra Corporation.
The Kafra services
are always on your side.
How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎来到卡普拉公司。
卡普拉服务永远在您身边。
请问有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666W-weeeelc-c-come
to th-the K-kaaafrrrra
C-coorpoor-r-ratioooonn...^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
^666666欢-欢-欢迎
光-光临卡-卡-卡普拉
公-公-公司……^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome. ^ff0000{0}^000000 Member.
The Kafra Coporation will stay with you wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎您，^ff0000{0}^000000会员。
无论您走到哪里，卡普拉公司都将与您同在。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
So, have you come from a faraway land to study our culture, or are you just sightseeing?
In either case, why not stay awhile?
The air is eternally heavy with the
scent of pleasant wildflowers.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
那么，您是远道而来研究我们的文化，还是只是来观光呢？
无论如何，何不稍作停留？
这里的空气中永远弥漫着
宜人野花的芬芳。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
With our many Kafra
service locations, you're never
far from home.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
凭借我们众多的卡普拉
服务网点，您永远不会
远离家园。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Because of the ^FF0000Limited
Transport Agreement^000000, the
Kafra Corporation cannot
provide Teleport Services
in the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
由于^FF0000有限运输协议^000000，
卡普拉公司无法在
修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国
提供瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We ask that you please
use the Airship Service
instead. Thank you for your
understanding and cooperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请您改用
飞空艇服务。
感谢您的理解与配合。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry but another guild member is using the guild storage
right now.  Please wait until that person is finished.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，目前另一位公会成员正在使用公会仓库。
请等待该成员使用完毕。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666S-s-ssoooorry,
y-you're a-a-aaaa
Nooviiice... N-neeeds
B-basic sssskill l-level 6...^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
^666666抱-抱歉，
你-你是新-新手……需-需要
基-基础技能等级6……^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您需要将初心者的基本技能等级提升至6级，才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Zeeeeeny...
M-more z-zeny...!
N-neeed 150... zeny...
Ergh! T-taking bl-blood~!^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
^666666泽-泽尼……
更-更多泽尼……！
需-需要150……泽尼……
呃啊！简-简直是抢钱~！^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足，
无法使用仓库服务。
我们的仓库访问费用为{0}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Thank you.. for... using...^000000
[Kafra Employee]
scripts.translation: [卡普拉服务员]

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Here, let me open
your Storage for you.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Service.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
来，让我为您打开仓库。
感谢您使用卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please choose
your destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请选择您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足，
无法使用瞬间移动服务。
传送到{0}的费用为{1}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，
手推车租赁服务
仅对商人职业开放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, Master Smiths,
Alchemists and Biochemists.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，
手推车租赁服务
仅对商人、铁匠、大师铁匠、
炼金术士和生物化学家开放。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
您已经装备了手推车。
很遗憾，我们无法同时向同一位顾客出租多辆手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can only rent a cart after learning the "Push Cart" skill.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
只有在学习了“手推车使用”技能后，才能租赁手推车。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Pushcart rental
fee is {0} zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
手推车租赁
费用为{0}泽尼。
您要租赁手推车吗？

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart.
scripts.translation: 租赁手推车。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，您的
泽尼不足，
无法支付{0}泽尼的
手推车租赁费用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Let's see...
{0}...
Ah, you have a total of
{1} Special Reserve Points.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
让我看看……
{0}……
啊，您总共有
{1}点特别储备积分。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
You can exchange your
Special Reserve Points for
rewards at the Kafra Main Office in Al De Baran. Please use our
convenient services to see the benefits of our rewards program.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
您可以在艾尔帕兰的卡普拉总部
将特别储备积分兑换为奖励。
请使用我们便捷的服务，
体验我们奖励计划的益处。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using
the Kafra Services.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
您的重生点
已保存于此
{0}。
感谢您使用
卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
We, here at Kafra Corporation,
are always endeavoring to provide you with the best services. We hope that we meet your adventuring needs and standards of excellence.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
我们卡普拉公司始终致力于为您提供最优质的服务。我们希望能够满足您的冒险需求及卓越标准。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
^666666Kaffffra n-never
diiiiiiiiiiiiiies. On...
On y-yooour siiiiide~^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
^666666卡-卡普拉永-永不
灭-灭亡。始-始终
在-在您身-身边~^000000

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Saved.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
已保存。
感谢您的惠顾。
